challenge.results: The example retains potential 1, then flow 2, then potential 3, then potential 7. Opposite kinds replace the former value. Same-kind addition occurs before the end-of-cycle assignment and the standard limits the lifetime of the retained value to the current iteration.

limitations: The claim addresses the abstract rule for direct source branch contributions in this dated edition. It leaves indirect forms, behavior across iterations, simulator internals and tool conformance outside scope.
